name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.99 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
